findings.description: The test is named and planned as proving that an invalid request to a closed tender returns 400 rather than 409. It never stubs the service to throw the closed-tender exception, and it never sets up a closed tender. It is effectively a duplicate of the other 400 tests. verifyNoInteractions does show the service isn't called. But the 400-over-409 precedence the plan asked for is never exercised against a service that would actually return 409.
